scope: Read-only saved-state reconstruction and forecast scoring; no new race or shared source edit. This remains separate from the directional-bound candidate and the rejected prior-bar-rate-hold predictor.

forwardValidation.timebase: Cumulative original240Hz physical dt; interpolate the two recorded physical states bracketing exactly0.06s. The duplicated120Hz outer race timestamps are not treated as separate elapsed time.
forwardValidation.unchangedTerms: Original nominal gpSpinPerSpeed*planningSpeed*priorYaw*cos(bodyLean), original planning combined lean, original roll rate and original prediction horizon held identical in every forecast. Only the lateral-force value changes.
forwardValidation.qualification: The actual future controls continue to vary. The final-Fx preview uses values resolved later in the current physical step and is diagnostic only at the original early planning point. The early-Fx preview uses the planning speed and preceding applied Fx already available there; its front-contact multiplier is independently recomputed from current load and planning-speed static load and equals the recorded plant multiplier at every sample. Unused wheel-torque excess inputs are zeroed and do not contribute to the lateral-force read-out. Previous-load controls replace only the tyre preparation load, retaining the CURRENT reaction in every roll forecast; this separates current force preparation from merely advancing relaxation. These immediate previews do not forecast future loads or inputs.

causalLimit: The load-only native experiment establishes immediate force-preparation inconsistency. Prediction scoring uses a single existing trajectory with changing future controls; it does not prove a future controller improves races. The mismatch becomes pronounced after83.8s; the earlier positive-roll manoeuvre is not attributed solely to this issue.
inputOwnership: Early preview uses current contact loads/grip/body pose, previous physical force/elastic/yaw/velocity state, prior applied Fx, planning speed and recomputed available frontContact. It reads only lateral force; unused later torque excess values are zeroed. Final-Fx preview is a separate diagnostic using data only known after pedal allocation. Every forecast retains the same current reaction and original nominal gyro term. Previous-load controls change tyre preparation load only.

historyOnlySeparation.definition: Rescale recorded tyre-frame Fy by current C_alpha/previous C_alpha using the exact native conditional, then immediately clamp to the current combined-force circle and project at the held bar. No new raw-force target, exponential relaxation, state advance or future steering input is evaluated. Current preparation stiffness is independently checked against the recorded real plant at every sample.
historyOnlySeparation.interpretation: Without any raw contact relaxation advance, current-preparation history retains about93% of the full preview RMSE reduction. Previous-load history is essentially the original forecast. This supports the narrower phase correction but does not prove a closed-loop race improvement.
